Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Dear V:TES Community,

Carl, Eric and I are seeking volunteers to participate in the playtest of a small set of Sabbat-themed V:TES cards. This playtest round will be open to all participants who register with one of us. Cards will be privately distributed via e-mail in PDF format for ease of printing. More precise details about the process will be provided to those who express interest. If you want to take part, please contact me <> or Carl Pilhatsch <> at your earliest convenience for more details.

Thank you for your attention and interest,

Carl, Eric and Jeff

When you are anvil, be patient; when a hammer, strike.

pckvtes.wordpress.com
@pckvtes

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Carl, Eric and Jeff.
Please stop being silly and rocking the V:TES boat.
Looks especially bad for Eric the Inner Circle Member...

In light of this I suggest that we modify the design team's contract (if there is any) so that the ownership of the cards designed is in the hands of the organization, not the designers. At least as long as there is no new publisher for the game (ie. until any possible money enters the picture).

If this forum's card suggestion threads are used to harvest for new card ideas for playtesting/future expansions then the same needs to be applied to all these suggestions/threads as well. So that by default when you suggest a card in this forum you are handing over the rights of those cards/ideas to VEKN.

Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: Brum
Messages.Body:
If a player has the time, conditions and ability to playtest, why would he be interest in working with something that is divisive, non official and reeks of personal agenda all over?

Why not work in the official Project?

Do you think it is being badly run? Do you think you could do a better job?
Awesome!
Please take this advise into account:
-Stop any type of action that is in parallel with the Expansion being tested now.
-Make a project (team description, communication methods, timings, possible theme, etc..). Apply it to VEKN (ICs, NCs, etc) for the next expansion.
-Be clear you guys want to be the 3 Lead Designers.
-Be open to VEKN's position on the number of cards and main themes. The IC's need to think long term. The Leads Designers of each expansion do not.

I'm sure this is much more helpful to us all. You included.
Unless you guys have issues with all the VEKN IC and most of the NCs.
If that's the case, you're a small minority of 3, because they're awesome people and I think they would take your case into consideration.
That is, if you don't keep burning your bridges.

Relax, don't do it,
Tiago

PS: As lead designer, I don't wish for any novel material or characters from the BYOS Lisboa: 1999 or the Official Storyline Friday 13th to be used outside of VEKN sanctioned projects at this time.
I'm sorry but I wouldn't feel good with such material being used in a project that divides us.
This would include Claudio Severino, but also any other cards I gave my opinion / input in, as I was under the notion it was to be released officially.
You can disregard my wish, of course. I will not comment or voice an opinion on the matter if you do, as I feel I would also be helping to divide us.

Messages.Author: AaronC
Messages.Body:
> direwolf wrote:
> V:EKN has a stranglehold on the development of new fan based cards, insomuch as they determine what cards are supported for their sanctioned tournaments.
>
> We are the 99%.
>
There is a lot of unharnessed energy and talent out there. There are a lot of projects that could be worked on besides just developing one new small set of cards, putting on the championship tournaments, and updating a few rules once a year.

I looked at the fan-run Star Trek site www.trekcc.org/, and they seem to do a lot with committees. It's true that if you are the only person in charge of marketing/rules/rankings/development you have a lot more control, but you can get a lot more done by leading a group of people. The role of the leader should be to see the projects that could be done and then to find the people who can do the work and to lead them, not to do all the work him or herself.

A lot of people on this board, such as Direwolf (okay, I won't tell them your real name ) have good ideas and energy, but they lack the "legitimacy" of VEKN since they have no role in the organization and don't have "Methuselah" standing in the community.

Personally I think that VTES can now be led by the players, but I know that I am in the minority. Does VTES have to be a like a vampire, frozen for eternity in the form it had at death? If the former design team wants to keep going, I say good for them.

Messages.Author: DeathInABottle
Messages.Body: Committees are a great idea, and probably would have done a lot to solve the design team's problems. I see no reason why you couldn't have one committee working on one expansion while another started prepping for the next, both creating cards under the coordination of one central leader. That leader wouldn't have anything to do with the actual creation of cards himself - he would only coordinate the process.
